player_prompt.intro:
Ami Player {player_id} JoJoJoin-re, 5x5 borde te 0-24 tak cell-gulir madhye khelchi.
Tumar pala-te, tumar chinha kono khali cell-e rakho, udaaharan '[12]' okare.
TUMI JITBE char-ta tumar chinha ek-saare rakhte paile — char-ta laghu cell samantar, usargata, ba tirchhe.
Player {player_id} hisabe ami '{symbol}'; amar pratidwandi '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ᱥᱟᱯᱲᱟᱣ ᱟᱠᱟᱱ ᱪᱟᱞ ᱫᱚ ᱥᱟᱹᱛ ᱞᱟᱹᱜᱤᱫ ᱛᱮ ᱵᱟᱝ ᱠᱟᱱᱟ.

game_action.placed: ᱯᱞᱮᱭᱟᱨ {player_id} ᱟᱡᱟᱜ ᱪᱤᱱᱦᱟᱹ ({symbol}) ᱥᱮᱞ {cell} ᱨᱮ ᱨᱟᱠᱷᱤ ᱮᱫᱟ.
